function.name: apdex_settings_api_ApdexSettingsApi_create_apdex_configuration
function.description: Creates a new Apdex configuration for an application, allowing customization of satisfactory, tolerable, and frustrated response time thresholds. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

application_id.description: The unique identifier for the application for which Apdex configuration is to be created.

satisfactory.description: The maximum response time (in seconds) for a user action to be considered satisfactory. This is a float type value.

tolerable.description: The maximum response time (in seconds) for a user action to be considered tolerable before frustration sets in. This is a float type value.

frustrated.description: The response time (in seconds) at which a user action is considered frustrated, indicating an unsatisfactory experience. This is a float type value.

thresholds.description: Threshold values defining the Apdex score categories.

name.description: A human-readable name for the Apdex configuration.

enabled.description: A flag to enable or disable this Apdex configuration.

function.name: delete_apdex_configuration
function.description: Deletes the specified Apdex configuration by its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Apdex configuration to delete.

function.name: get_all_apdex_configurations
function.description: Retrieve a list of all Apdex (Application Performance Index) configurations that define satisfactory thresholds for application response times. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

application_id.description: The unique identifier of the application for which to fetch Apdex settings. If not provided, Apdex settings for all applications will be returned.

include_thresholds.description: Whether to include the threshold values in the response. If false, only the configuration names and IDs will be returned.
